desc: Plastic 3 Pieces Fridge Food Storage Container Set with Inner Strainer & Clips Lids for Organizing Fruits, Vegetables, Foods 3 Pieces Plastic Fridge Food Storage Container Set Designed to help organize and store fruits, vegetables and foods inside the refrigerator in a practical way. The containers come with an internal strainer and snap lids, which help to allocate a separate space for each type of food and keep shelves and drawers tidy during storage. The internal strainer provides the possibility of separating contents from liquids collected at the bottom depending on the type of food and storage method, while the snap lids help secure the lid while the containers are placed inside the refrigerator. With 3 pieces, different varieties can be divided and a can be customized for each set of ingredients. 3 PIECE SET: the set includes three containers that can be used separately to organize different types of foods, helping to divide the contents of the refrigerator and allocate a clear space for fruits, vegetables and food. INNER STRAINER: each container has an internal strainer that helps keep contents separate from liquids on the bottom depending on the nature of the food, providing a practical way to store some types of fruits and vegetables.
